proposition: The first letter (to Yazdī, on the point of leaving Isfahan for the Hijaz) probably reflects a pilgrimage made during his first Shiraz-Isfahan period (ca. 810-17/1408-14), not the beginning of his studies abroad; MK places that period under the patronage first of Pīr Muḥammad b. ʿUmar Shaykh and then of Iskandar b. ʿUmar Shaykh.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī
mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
